# 1. Load case-crossover dataframe

```{r load}
case_crossover_df <- readRDS(paste0(objects_folder, "case_crossover_df.RDS"))
setDT(case_crossover_df)
```

# 2. Build crossbases (primary spec)

```{r crossbases}
cb_runoff <- crossbasis(
  as.matrix(case_crossover_df[, paste0("runoff_Lag", 0:28), with = FALSE]),
  lag = c(0, 28), argvar = list(fun = "lin"), arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 3)
)
cb_soil_moisture <- crossbasis(
  as.matrix(case_crossover_df[, paste0("soil_moisture_Lag", 0:28), with = FALSE]),
  lag = c(0, 28), argvar = list(fun = "lin"), arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 3)
)
cb_temperature <- crossbasis(
  as.matrix(case_crossover_df[, paste0("temperature_Lag", 0:28), with = FALSE]),
  lag = c(0, 28), argvar = list(fun = "lin"), arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 3)
)
cb_precipitation <- crossbasis(
  as.matrix(case_crossover_df[, paste0("precipitation_Lag", 0:28), with = FALSE]),
  lag = c(0, 28), argvar = list(fun = "lin"), arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 3)
)
cb_wind_speed <- crossbasis(
  as.matrix(case_crossover_df[, paste0("wind_speed_Lag", 0:28), with = FALSE]),
  lag = c(0, 28), argvar = list(fun = "lin"), arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 3)
)
cb_anseriformes <- crossbasis(
  as.matrix(case_crossover_df[, paste0("anseriformes_Lag", 0:28), with = FALSE]),
  lag = c(0, 28), argvar = list(fun = "lin"),
  arglag = list(fun = "strata", breaks = c(7, 14, 21))
)
```

# 3. Fit primary clogit and extract Wald CIs

```{r fit-wald}
freq_model <- clogit(
  outbreak_binary ~
    cb_runoff + cb_soil_moisture + cb_temperature +
    cb_precipitation + cb_wind_speed + cb_anseriformes +
    strata(stratum_id),
  method = "efron", data = case_crossover_df
)

beta_hat <- coef(freq_model)
V_hat    <- vcov(freq_model)

lag_seq        <- 0:28
lag_basis_met  <- do.call(dlnm::onebasis, c(list(x = lag_seq), attr(cb_runoff,       "arglag")))
lag_basis_bird <- do.call(dlnm::onebasis, c(list(x = lag_seq), attr(cb_anseriformes, "arglag")))
contrast_met   <- 0.5 * colSums(lag_basis_met)
contrast_bird  <- 0.5 * colSums(lag_basis_bird)

predictor_specs <- list(
  "Runoff"        = list(prefix = "cb_runoff",        is_bird = FALSE),
  "Soil Moisture" = list(prefix = "cb_soil_moisture", is_bird = FALSE),
  "Temperature"   = list(prefix = "cb_temperature",   is_bird = FALSE),
  "Precipitation" = list(prefix = "cb_precipitation", is_bird = FALSE),
  "Wind Speed"    = list(prefix = "cb_wind_speed",    is_bird = FALSE),
  "Anseriformes"  = list(prefix = "cb_anseriformes",  is_bird = TRUE)
)

wald_tbl <- rbindlist(lapply(names(predictor_specs), function(name) {
  spec <- predictor_specs[[name]]
  contrast <- if (spec$is_bird) contrast_bird else contrast_met
  cols <- grep(paste0("^", spec$prefix, "v"), names(beta_hat))
  b    <- beta_hat[cols]; V <- V_hat[cols, cols]
  lo   <- as.numeric(contrast %*% b)
  se   <- sqrt(as.numeric(t(contrast) %*% V %*% contrast))
  data.table(
    Predictor = name,
    `Wald OR (95% CI)` = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)",
                                exp(lo), exp(lo - 1.96 * se), exp(lo + 1.96 * se))
  )
}))
```

# 4. Profile-likelihood CIs on each crossbasis coefficient

```{r profile-ci}
# Profile-likelihood CIs are computed per individual coefficient by survival::confint.
# For each predictor we then need a small-sample-robust CI on the cumulative log-OR
# (a linear combination of basis coefficients). Two equivalent approaches:
#  (a) Profile-likelihood CI per coefficient, then propagate via contrast vector
#      using a delta-method-equivalent: this is approximate.
#  (b) Reparameterize the model so the contrast is a single coefficient and profile that.
# We use (b) — the cleaner approach — by adding a single linear-combination column
# directly to the design matrix and profiling that.

profile_ci_for_predictor <- function(prefix, contrast) {
  cols <- grep(paste0("^", prefix, "v"), names(beta_hat))
  # Build the linear-combination column: sum_j contrast[j] * X_{:,col_j}
  # Then a model with this single column has slope = log-OR at +0.5 SD cumulative.
  X_all <- model.matrix(freq_model)
  cb_cols <- X_all[, cols, drop = FALSE]
  lc <- as.numeric(cb_cols %*% contrast)

  # Drop the original crossbasis columns and replace with the linear-combination
  other_cols <- setdiff(seq_len(ncol(X_all)), cols)
  Xnew <- cbind(lc, X_all[, other_cols, drop = FALSE])
  colnames(Xnew)[1] <- "linear_combo"

  # Fit reparameterized clogit using survival::coxph trick — pass via formula
  df_reparam <- copy(case_crossover_df)
  df_reparam[, linear_combo := lc]
  other_terms <- setdiff(names(beta_hat), names(beta_hat)[cols])

  # Build formula
  rhs <- paste(c("linear_combo", paste0("`", other_terms, "`")), collapse = " + ")
  # Reassign the rest of the crossbasis matrix as data columns
  for (j in other_cols) {
    df_reparam[[colnames(X_all)[j]]] <- X_all[, j]
  }
  form <- as.formula(paste0("outbreak_binary ~ ", rhs, " + strata(stratum_id)"))

  m_reparam <- clogit(form, method = "efron", data = df_reparam)
  ci <- tryCatch(suppressMessages(confint(m_reparam, parm = "linear_combo")),
                 error = function(e) NA_real_)
  if (is.na(ci[1])) {
    return(c(NA_real_, NA_real_))
  }
  ci
}

profile_tbl <- rbindlist(lapply(names(predictor_specs), function(name) {
  spec <- predictor_specs[[name]]
  contrast <- if (spec$is_bird) contrast_bird else contrast_met
  cols <- grep(paste0("^", spec$prefix, "v"), names(beta_hat))
  b    <- beta_hat[cols]
  lo_point <- as.numeric(contrast %*% b)
  ci <- profile_ci_for_predictor(spec$prefix, contrast)
  data.table(
    Predictor = name,
    `Profile-LR OR (95% CI)` = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)",
                                      exp(lo_point), exp(ci[1]), exp(ci[2]))
  )
}))
```

# 5. Cluster bootstrap CIs (stratum-level resampling)

```{r bootstrap-ci}
set.seed(2026)
n_boot <- 500
strata_unique <- unique(case_crossover_df$stratum_id)

boot_one <- function() {
  sampled <- sample(strata_unique, size = length(strata_unique), replace = TRUE)
  # Build bootstrap dataset by stacking sampled strata with renamed IDs
  boot_df <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_along(sampled), function(j) {
    rows <- case_crossover_df[stratum_id == sampled[j]]
    rows[, stratum_id := paste0("boot_", j)]
    rows
  }))

  cb_runoff_b <- crossbasis(
    as.matrix(boot_df[, paste0("runoff_Lag", 0:28), with = FALSE]),
    lag = c(0, 28), argvar = list(fun = "lin"), arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 3)
  )
  cb_soil_b <- crossbasis(
    as.matrix(boot_df[, paste0("soil_moisture_Lag", 0:28), with = FALSE]),
    lag = c(0, 28), argvar = list(fun = "lin"), arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 3)
  )
  cb_temp_b <- crossbasis(
    as.matrix(boot_df[, paste0("temperature_Lag", 0:28), with = FALSE]),
    lag = c(0, 28), argvar = list(fun = "lin"), arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 3)
  )
  cb_precip_b <- crossbasis(
    as.matrix(boot_df[, paste0("precipitation_Lag", 0:28), with = FALSE]),
    lag = c(0, 28), argvar = list(fun = "lin"), arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 3)
  )
  cb_wind_b <- crossbasis(
    as.matrix(boot_df[, paste0("wind_speed_Lag", 0:28), with = FALSE]),
    lag = c(0, 28), argvar = list(fun = "lin"), arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 3)
  )
  cb_bird_b <- crossbasis(
    as.matrix(boot_df[, paste0("anseriformes_Lag", 0:28), with = FALSE]),
    lag = c(0, 28), argvar = list(fun = "lin"),
    arglag = list(fun = "strata", breaks = c(7, 14, 21))
  )

  m_b <- tryCatch(clogit(
    outbreak_binary ~ cb_runoff_b + cb_soil_b + cb_temp_b +
                      cb_precip_b + cb_wind_b + cb_bird_b +
                      strata(stratum_id),
    method = "efron", data = boot_df
  ), error = function(e) NULL)

  if (is.null(m_b)) return(rep(NA_real_, length(predictor_specs)))

  b_b <- coef(m_b)
  out <- sapply(names(predictor_specs), function(name) {
    spec <- predictor_specs[[name]]
    contrast <- if (spec$is_bird) contrast_bird else contrast_met
    # The bootstrap model's coef names end in _b, e.g. cb_runoff_bv1.l1
    prefix_b <- paste0(spec$prefix, "_bv")
    # Bird suffix differs: cb_anseriformes -> cb_bird_b in bootstrap
    if (spec$is_bird) prefix_b <- "cb_bird_bv"
    if (spec$prefix == "cb_soil_moisture")    prefix_b <- "cb_soil_bv"
    if (spec$prefix == "cb_temperature")      prefix_b <- "cb_temp_bv"
    if (spec$prefix == "cb_precipitation")    prefix_b <- "cb_precip_bv"
    if (spec$prefix == "cb_wind_speed")       prefix_b <- "cb_wind_bv"
    if (spec$prefix == "cb_anseriformes")     prefix_b <- "cb_bird_bv"
    if (spec$prefix == "cb_runoff")           prefix_b <- "cb_runoff_bv"
    cols <- grep(paste0("^", prefix_b), names(b_b))
    if (length(cols) == 0) return(NA_real_)
    b_sub <- b_b[cols]
    as.numeric(contrast %*% b_sub)
  })
  out
}

boot_mat <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(n_boot), function(i) boot_one()))
colnames(boot_mat) <- names(predictor_specs)

boot_tbl <- rbindlist(lapply(names(predictor_specs), function(name) {
  spec <- predictor_specs[[name]]
  contrast <- if (spec$is_bird) contrast_bird else contrast_met
  cols <- grep(paste0("^", spec$prefix, "v"), names(beta_hat))
  b    <- beta_hat[cols]
  point <- as.numeric(contrast %*% b)
  log_or_boot <- boot_mat[, name]
  log_or_boot <- log_or_boot[is.finite(log_or_boot)]
  ci <- quantile(log_or_boot, c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)
  data.table(
    Predictor = name,
    `Bootstrap OR (95% CI)` = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)",
                                     exp(point), exp(ci[1]), exp(ci[2])),
    `Bootstrap N` = length(log_or_boot)
  )
}))
```

# 6. Side-by-side: Wald / Profile-LR / Bootstrap

```{r combine}
combined <- Reduce(function(a, b) merge(a, b, by = "Predictor"),
                   list(wald_tbl, profile_tbl, boot_tbl))
print(combined)

ft <- combined %>%
  flextable() %>%
  fontsize(size = 10, part = "all") %>%
  autofit() %>%
  align(align = "center", part = "all") %>%
  theme_booktabs()

doc <- read_docx() %>%
  body_add_flextable(ft) %>%
  body_add_par(
    paste0(
      "Cumulative OR estimates (per +0.5 SD, lag 0-28 d) for the primary 6-variable case-crossover DLNM under three interval-estimation methods. Wald: asymptotic standard error from the model fit. Profile likelihood: reparameterized clogit with the cumulative contrast as a single coefficient, profile-LR interval. Bootstrap: 500 cluster-bootstrap resamples (stratum as cluster), refit primary model on each, percentile interval. Profile-LR and bootstrap intervals are more accurate than Wald at small samples (N = ", nrow(case_crossover_df), " case-zone-days)."
    ),
    style = "Normal"
  )
print(doc, target = paste0(tables_sensitivity_folder, "Table_ProfileLR_Bootstrap_CI.docx"))
```

# 7. Save

```{r save}
saveRDS(list(
  wald_tbl    = wald_tbl,
  profile_tbl = profile_tbl,
  boot_tbl    = boot_tbl,
  combined    = combined,
  boot_mat    = boot_mat
), paste0(objects_folder, "profile_lr_bootstrap.RDS"))
```
